source: MikroElektronika EEPROM 3 Click: 2D and 3D files (eeprom-3-click-2d-and-3d-files.zip, EEPROM3_click_v101a.dxf; silkscreen 256KB, I2C interface, ADD 1/0, U1, R2, R3, PWR, R1, PWR SEL 3V3/5V, EEPROM 3 click) and schematic v100 (AT24CM02 SOIC-8, A2 jumper to GND, WP to GND). Positions from the DXF pads and the rendered silkscreen; the SOIC-8 pads are not reported by dxf_pads (positions read from the render). Jumpers drawn in their default positions (ADD 0, PWR SEL 3V3).
